messages.subject_clean: Grouping by time
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

I am trying to group 50K key-values pairs in each subset. Now the thing is
each of these subsets are time ordered. So hopefully, I am trying to get
get packet x and the next 49999 packets that are after x. The method I
am using now is

1. found the rate of packets arrival. They vary from 350 - 850 /sec.
2. So that means each subset will have packets that arrival in 58 - 143 sec blocks.

Now, what I am worried about is the variablity of 350 - 850 can cause two types of problems. If I am packets subsets with the highest value (850) I am wasting block size ( and my data set has about 100 billion packets).  If I go with the lower I might over packet and break the subset.  I am wondering if there is a smarter way to group these packets based on time. Any ideas?

Thank You.
Ashrith
